derived_info.summary: ECA 1000L (Methyltetrahydrophthalic Anhydride, MTHPA, CAS# 34090-76-1) is a clear light to yellow liquid epoxy curing agent with a pour point of -27°C. It is used to convert epoxy resins into highly crosslinked polymers with excellent physical and electrical properties. The product contains a minimum of 99% MTHPA with strict specifications for impurities (≤0.1% MAN, ≤100 ppm volatiles, and ≤2.0% free acid). ECA 1000L is particularly valuable for demanding applications including filament winding, pultrusion, lamination, electrical encapsulating, insulating, casting, and potting. When formulated with various epoxy resins (83-116 phr) and 1 part 1-Methylimidazole, it achieves glass transition temperatures ranging from 137°C to 220°C after a standard cure cycle (1h/120°C + 1h/220°C). The highest Tg (220°C) is achieved with cycloaliphatic epoxy systems. Like other anhydrides, ECA 1000L reacts with water to form diacids, requiring protection from moisture contamination during storage. Safety precautions are necessary as the product is classified as a primary skin and eye irritant, necessitating appropriate PPE including chemical goggles, impenetrable gloves, and adequate ventilation during handling.

personas.sales_summary: ECA 1000L (MTHPA) is our premium liquid anhydride curing agent that delivers exceptional performance in demanding composite and electrical applications. This clear light to yellow liquid offers an ideal combination of processing ease with a low pour point (-27°C) and superior cured properties. With a high purity specification (minimum 99% MTHPA), ECA 1000L creates highly crosslinked polymers featuring excellent physical and electrical characteristics. It's particularly valuable for critical applications including filament winding, pultrusion, lamination, and electrical encapsulation systems. Our formulation testing demonstrates ECA 1000L's versatility across multiple epoxy systems, achieving glass transition temperatures up to 220°C with cycloaliphatic epoxies. This makes it perfect for high-temperature applications where thermal stability is essential. The product's consistent quality ensures reliable processing and end-product performance, while its liquid form simplifies handling compared to solid anhydrides. Available from our Pasadena, Texas facility, ECA 1000L represents a trusted solution for formulators seeking to optimize both processing efficiency and final product performance in advanced composite and electrical insulation systems.
personas.technical_summary: ECA 1000L (Methyltetrahydrophthalic Anhydride, CAS# 34090-76-1) is a high-purity anhydride epoxy curing agent with minimum 99% MTHPA content. This clear light to yellow liquid has a molecular weight of 166, pour point of -27°C, and strict specifications for impurities (≤0.1% MAN, ≤100 ppm volatiles, ≤2.0% free acid). When formulated with standard BPA liquid epoxy at 84 phr, it produces a mix with 590 cP viscosity, 32 minute gel time at 100°C, and 139°C Tg after standard cure (1h/120°C + 1h/220°C). With cycloaliphatic epoxy at 116 phr, it achieves superior thermal performance with 220°C Tg. Optimal formulations include 1 part 1-Methylimidazole as accelerator. ECA 1000L reacts with water to form diacids, requiring moisture protection during storage. The product is classified as a primary skin and eye irritant requiring appropriate PPE including chemical goggles, impenetrable gloves, and adequate ventilation. First aid for exposure includes flushing with water for at least 15 minutes and seeking medical attention for eye contact. Recommended cure schedule is 1 hour at 120°C followed by 1 hour post-cure at 220°C for optimal properties.
